args.body: Hi Rowan, thanks for speaking to us today. We've noted that you're using your own contractor, Riverside Services (Freya), for the communal weeds and side hedge at Flat 26, 46 Copperfield Walk, and that you'll pay them directly. We won't send our own contractor. Two quick things: (1) please send us the start date once Freya confirms it, ideally by Friday 7 November, so we can keep our record right; (2) you mentioned about £20,000 on the call, which sounds high for this work, so could you check that figure is right? It doesn't affect us as you're paying directly, but we want our notes to be accurate. We'll check in with you on 7 November.
